In [[69 BBY/Legends|69 BBY]], the outlaw [[Byrch Dyshkava|Byrch "The Padawan" Dyshkava]] raided the town of [[Bartyn's Landing]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. The [[Security Chief (ORO)|Security Chief]] organized a '''raid''' to Dyshkava's campament but they were massacred.
